reviews.author: Les Porter
reviews.text: Tim has been great. I always took my 1973 Mustang to him because he would spend the extra time to find the issue and look for cost effective fixes.

reviews.author: Jeff Butler
reviews.text: I had to get some brake work done on my truck recently. I called multiple shops getting prices for the work that needed to be done before I found Loftin's. His price was not only much lower than anywhere else but he was able to get the work done on the same day! This is the only place I'll take my vehicles for repair work now! Extremely trustworthy! I highly recommend!
